name: Guangdong Shunna Electric Co., Ltd
summary: Guangdong Shunna Electric Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of power transmission and distribution equipment and control systems in China. The company offers dry-type transformers, prefabricated substations, combined transformers, medium and low voltage switchgear, dry-type reactors, and grounding products. Its products are used power systems, including generation, transmission, distribution, and consumption, playing a vital role in power grids, new energy, data centers, semiconductors, rail transportation, electric vehicle charging stations, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure construction, and real estate development.
